name: insights_query
title: Query ad insights
description:
Query one bounded insights page, then follow next_cursor when needed.

Call ``insights_capabilities`` first for valid combinations. The default
page contains 25 rows and the MCP maximum is 100 rows to keep tool results
within agent context limits. Prefer the default instead of requesting the
maximum unless a larger page is necessary. Daily account, campaign, and
adset queries automatically roll up aggregation-safe metrics from ad rows;
reach and frequency remain exact native metrics at the requested level.
Filter structured metrics with
``action_types`` and ``attribution_windows`` instead of returning every raw
Meta action tuple. Both filters are REQUIRED for actions, action_values,
and other structured metrics. For purchase analysis, for example, supply
action_types=["omni_purchase"], attribution_windows=["value"]. Choose the
action and attribution window that match the question; they are not inferred.
Use sorting and ``min_spend`` before paginating for top-N
analysis; use ``entity_ids`` for targeted follow-up queries.

name: insights_rank
title: Rank ad performance
description:
Rank compact period performance without returning raw insight pages.

Use one entity level per call and choose an explicit conversion action and
attribution window for conversion metrics. ``highest`` and ``lowest`` are
numeric extremes, not automatic business judgments. ``global`` returns one
ranking across the requested accounts; ``per_account`` returns one bounded
ranking for each account. Add minimum evidence filters for meaningful results.
The result never includes raw structured Meta metric arrays or a pagination
cursor.
